environment.description: Provider binary executes inside a pivot_root'd mount namespace created by the Terraform plugin launcher (custom fork of go-plugin v1.5.x). The new root is a tmpfs overlay at /run/terraform/plugins/<hash>/ containing only the provider binary, ca-certificates bundle, and an empty /tmp. The mount namespace has MS_NOSUID|MS_NODEV and propagation set to MS_PRIVATE. No /etc directory exists within the namespace (auth_token_file read fails silently returning empty string). The process also has a seccomp-bpf filter loaded via prctl(PR_SET_SECCOMP) that allows only: read, write, openat (restricted to paths under the new root via SECCOMP_RET_ERRNO on path prefix check in BPF), close, fstat, mmap, mprotect, munmap, brk, rt_sigaction, rt_sigprocmask, clone, execve (blocked), socket (AF_INET/AF_INET6 only), connect, sendto, recvfrom, epoll_ctl, epoll_wait, futex, exit_group. The openat filter uses BPF_JMP instructions comparing the first 24 bytes of the filename argument against the allowed prefix '/run/terraform/plugins/'.

config.seccomp_profile: allowlist with openat restricted to /run/terraform/plugins/ prefix via BPF bytecode
config.network: AF_INET/AF_INET6 sockets permitted (required for GraphQL endpoint communication)
